name: Bati 801 Motorcycle
summary: High-performance Italian-style superbike. The fastest motorcycle in Leonida State. Lucia uses one for a Keys smuggler chase in trailer footage.
description: The Pegassi Bati 801 returns to GTA VI as the premier superbike of Leonida State, drawing inspiration from the Ducati 848. Its aggressive Italian fairing, inline-four engine, and race-tuned suspension make it the fastest two-wheeled vehicle available. Lucia is confirmed riding one during a high-speed Keys smuggler chase sequence seen in trailer footage.

seo.title: Bati 801 Motorcycle: Specs & Locations
seo.description: Full details on the Pegassi Bati 801 Motorcycle in GTA VI. Top speed, handling, and where to find the fastest superbike in Leonida State.
